English.Char_Desc_2000:
Open-source f.lux alternative for Mac. The macOS app for your circadian rhythm.
Abendrot is a native macOS menu-bar app that warms built-in and external displays using the methods available on that Mac, with a screen-tint fallback when direct warming is unavailable. Sunset mode uses the Mac's system time zone or a chosen city without requesting Location permission.
Features: - Per-display warmth across built-in and external displays, with visible method status and a screen-tint fallback - Everyday warmth down to 1900 K, plus an optional deeper Cozy mode - Reveal True Color global shortcut (Option-Command-T by default, hold or toggle) when accurate color is needed - Per-app and full-screen warmth exclusions - Bundled abendrot CLI for scripts and AI coding assistants, with machine-readable JSON output - Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple; universal for Apple silicon and Intel on macOS 12+ - MIT license, free, no account, no ads, and no Mac-app usage telemetry (settings and statistics stay local; Sparkle update checks contact GitHub)
General wellness utility, not a medical device. Abendrot changes display color appearance and makes no claim to diagnose, treat, or improve sleep or any condition.
Website: https://abendrot.app/ Download: https://abendrot.app/download/ Homebrew: brew install --cask matthewrball/tap/abendrot Source: https://github.com/matthewrball/abendrot
